stored.note: Reference values from reference_study.mjs (component-wise observed-order Richardson on chordwise 96/128/192 and spanwise 48/64/96 levels), cross-term (separability) estimates from three meshes refined in both directions, and the coverage summary of both sequences.

twistReference.note: Outboard six-component wrench (N, N mm about the aircraft origin) of the reference load at the strip stations of the Fine delivery grid of the editable fixture (strips = differences) and at the torsion cut stations k L / 16; uncertainties of the force and of the moment about the quarter-chord load-line point of each station (cutLinePoint).
